description: This file is a PHP script related to the TestLink test management system. It handles report generation, initialization, and processing for test plan metrics, including setting up GUI components, processing user input, and generating report output.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI settings and data for the test plan metrics report, including fetching test plan and project info, platforms, and user-selected filters.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and processes request parameters and user input, returning a structured arguments object.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Builds email configuration details for report distribution, including the email subject line.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has the rights to access test plan metrics.
